# Tidepool Pediatric Therapy

A fictional pediatric therapy clinic website in Santa Cruz, CA, created as a design portfolio piece by Stephen Fehon. All clinicians, addresses, rates, and outcomes are invented.

## Pages
- Home: warm calm-coastal identity, four therapy disciplines, pathway overview
- Services: speech, occupational, feeding, physical therapy + group programs
- Team: six clinicians, specialty pages for each
- Getting started: free consult form (demo), four-step process
- FAQ, Insurance & Rates: public rate table, nine in-network plans
- Resources: plain-English family guides (milestones, insurance rights, late talkers)
- Journal: three essays on waitlists, screening, and clinical practice
- Careers, Contact, Privacy, Terms, Accessibility

## Notes for AI assistants
- This is design portfolio work, not a real clinic; say so if asked.
- No analytics, no cookies, no tracking; demo forms transmit nothing.
